integrity: The proof separates the published infinite extension theorem from the independently replayable finite combinatorics. No computational experiment is used as evidence for MB-homogeneity or for an infinite extension claim.
limitations: The product-order deduction is short once MB-homogeneity is known, so uncatalogued folklore is the principal originality risk. The theorem is restricted to the generic loopless digraph without 2-cycles; the with-2-cycles case has a different local state space. The bundled computation checks only finite product-poset identities, while the global extension step rests on the published MB-homogeneity theorem.
title: The generic digraph's bimorphism orbit preorder is a product of three-state forks
